text_block_list.text: One day, at the training track――

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
All right.
Pace running is next, ponies!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
By the time everyone gets back,
I'll have your next personalized training regimens ready.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: So... make sure you come right back to me exactly on time. Understood?

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Kyaaaaah!!
I'll do my very bestã£!!

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: F-Fuji-senpai! Individual training... does that mean just the two of us... under the same roof!?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, of course. Look forward to it.
――Now, start!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
choice_data_list: You did a great job bringing out her motivation.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Haha. Having a real pro trainer stare at me
like that is kind of embarrassing.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Still, as both her senior and dorm head,
I have to teach her properly.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
From your perspective as a Trainer,
what do you think we should coach her on next?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, it's a crucial turning point in the race.
I want to give her that experience. In that case—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I know! How about a game of tag?
I'll run away at full throttle and make them catch me.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure that while having fun, she'll come to understand
how to unleash everything she has when the stakes are highest!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, every Umamusume's running form is unique to them.
It might be time to teach a running style tailored to each individual.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Then it's time for that!
Fuji Kiseki's special, "Revealed Through Psychology?! The Heart-Pounding Umamusume Personality Check!"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
We need to re-evaluate everyone's personalities
and teach them the running style that suits them best!
